faqs.q: Can an AI agent send follow-ups on its own?
faqs.a: Not by default. Each email it drafts waits in Needs you; you can give an AI agent more freedom once its drafts need no edits.

faqs.q: Does it work with Pipedrive or Salesforce instead of HubSpot?
faqs.a: Both are in viaSocket’s catalog. Name your CRM in the sentence to Captain and it plans with that app.

faqs.q: Will it update deals in HubSpot?
faqs.a: It can when the job needs it, and any change in your apps asks you first.

faqs.q: What does it not do yet?
faqs.a: It does not make calls or send SMS; follow-ups go by email from Gmail. It drafts, it does not negotiate: discounts and terms stay with you. It does not send sequences to cold lists; it follows up people already in your pipeline.
